notes.title: 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor is Now Available!
notes.content:
Good morning, good afternoon, and good evening to all you puzzle masters! 
Exciting times are here! The latest installment in the 3D Escape Room series - 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor- -is now officially available on Steam! 


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612480"][/dynamiclink]

Since the demo version was released two months ago, we have received a great deal of valuable feedback and suggestions from players. Thank you all very much for your enthusiastic participation! 

It is with your voices that we have polished and optimized the game experience in many ways in the official version, striving to present a more perfect state. 



As the much-anticipated sequel, our goal is to bring you that long-lost sense of classic escapism, while incorporating More novel surprises! We've gone all out to bring all-around evolution while inheriting the essence of its predecessor:

A wider visual dimension: a new goggle feature!  - Unlock a whole new perspective on the world! 

MORE IMMERSIVE STORY: A complete and suspenseful storyline - Uncover the manor's dusty secrets step by step. 

RICHER EXPLORATION: 16 SECRET ROOMS & OVER 12 HOURS OF GAMEPLAY - Satisfy your craving for immersive puzzle solving. 

MORE BRAIN-BLOWING CHALLENGES: More ingenious puzzles & fun mini-games - Stimulate your logic & insight. 

More exquisite visual experience: comprehensively upgraded beautiful models - to create a more realistic and fascinating environment for you. 


🎁 Premiere Discounts & Demo Version[olist]
Limited Time Premiere Discounts: To celebrate the release, now through August 7, get 20% off when you purchase 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor! Now, my friends, is the perfect time to return to the secret room! 

The demo is still open: Still on the fence? Or are you a new player who just discovered us? Feel free to download the free demo on the store page to get a taste of the game for yourself! 


[/olist]🗣️ Join our puzzle community! 
We invite all players to:

Join the Steam Community Discussion Forum and share your tips, secrets, or challenges! 

Your feedback is vital to us! Our team will keep an eye on the community and further optimize and update the game based on players' opinions to polish the game experience to perfection. 

Now, it's time to push open the dusty door of 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor and reveal its deep secrets! We'll see you in the puzzles!

notes.title: 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor Demo Now Available!​
notes.content:
Good morning, good afternoon, and good evening, players!

We are thrilled to announce that the free demo for 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor is now live! Additionally, we will be participating in the Steam June Next Fest to meet you all at this gaming extravaganza!

Wishlist now ↓↓↓

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612480/3D_Escape_Room_Mystic_Manor/

Demo Highlights

The demo version of 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor includes two complete levels with approximately 45 minutes of gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595209/a30abc911577bae0355239c095cb0d2bdd28b698.gif

The full version will feature 16 uniquely styled rooms, over 12 hours of gameplay, and hundreds of puzzles/mini-games encompassing logic deduction, mathematical calculations, item combinations, and more...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595209/d7d8a7b7ac4ad919d4ca6372f9910087d1baaadf.gif

In our game, you'll unlock an additional visual dimension - manipulating mechanical structures inside objects through vision to discover hidden clues invisible to the naked eye!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595209/db05fd22ecf8c80d1073ac0aa7179df227704c4d.gif

Moreover, the game rooms authentically recreate specific historical eras and local cultural elements. We've seamlessly integrated these beautiful visual components with puzzle challenges, allowing you to enjoy exploring exquisite scenes while solving mysteries!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595209/50c06bcada418af120a7f26af4f780ea40bf9c9a.gif

Experience the free demo of 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor now and get a head start on this thrilling puzzle-solving adventure!

notes.title: The "3D Escape Room" series is about to release its third installment!
notes.content:
Good day, players!

Today we're thrilled to announce the next installment in the 3D Escape Room series – 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor is coming soon!

In the game, you inherit your grandfather's legacy - a manor. While exploring this manor, you discover unspeakable secrets hidden within.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/a30abc911577bae0355239c095cb0d2bdd28b698.gif

Driven by curiosity, you open door after door in the ancient mansion, follow clues, solve magnificent puzzles and mechanisms, and attempt to uncover the truth buried beneath this ancient manor.


Mind-Bending Puzzles

The game includes 16 uniquely styled rooms, over 12 hours of gameplay, hundreds of puzzles and mini-games covering logical reasoning, mathematical calculations, item combinations, and more... Various types of puzzles are perfectly integrated with the story. Use your keen observation and powerful logical reasoning to solve these exciting puzzles and sharpen your wisdom!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/d7d8a7b7ac4ad919d4ca6372f9910087d1baaadf.gif

Magical X-Ray Eyepiece

In our game, you will unlock another visual dimension! Manipulate internal mechanical structures by seeing through object surfaces and discover mysterious clues invisible to the naked eye!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/db05fd22ecf8c80d1073ac0aa7179df227704c4d.gif

Breathtaking Graphics & 3D Visuals

The rooms in the game authentically recreate specific historical eras and local cultural elements from the story's setting. We've combined these beautiful visual elements with puzzle challenges, allowing you to enjoy exploring these exquisite scenes while solving puzzles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/50c06bcada418af120a7f26af4f780ea40bf9c9a.gif



Additionally, enjoy a 20% launch discount for the first two weeks! Don't miss this chance – add to your wishlist now↓↓↓

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612480/3D_Escape_Room_Mystic_Manor/

notes.title: Optimization Patch Released
notes.content:
Dear Detectives,
The latest optimization patch for 3D Escape Room: Detective Story is now live! This update includes the following improvements:

1.Adjusted camera control logic for better operation

2.Fixed operation issues when the game runs above 60 FPS

3.Resolved operation anomalies in Chapter 2 "Butterfly Gears"

4.Fixed valve operation issues in Chapter 4 "Steam Train"

5.Addressed several other known issues

Thank you for your support and feedback! Return to the puzzle world and continue your detective journey.
